# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Educational Services | Multi-Sector: Private college plus two divisions

| Universal method | [step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md](../../../../00_universal-framework/projects/step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md) |
| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** GLBA Safeguards Rule (as enforced by FSA for Title IV institutions), 16 CFR 314.4
**Why:** It is the only prescriptive, audited cybersecurity control requirement in U.S. education: FSA tests it in the annual compliance audit, and findings can affect Title IV eligibility. FERPA is disclosure-oriented with no control catalog, so pair it with FERPA's 'reasonable methods' access control requirement. For K-12 districts outside Title IV, use NIST CSF 2.0 (or CIS Controls) plus FERPA/COPPA/CIPA.
